title: Major Shonen Jump Series to End With the Perfect Final Villain Twist No One Saw Coming
content: 2026 has been a big year for manga fans, especially those of Shonen Jump , as the magazine continues its trend of debuting new series while many others are either being canceled or reaching their conclusion.
author: ComicBook

title: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, Retired Racehorse and Umamusume Character Inspiration Has Died
content: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, the racehorse who inspired the Umamusume : Pretty Derby character, died on August 2. The former racehorse was 31 at the time of his passing. Shigeo Nakanishi, a member of the Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi Association, broke the news on the group’s website.
author: Anime Corner

title: Almost 22 Years Later, Bleach Finally Debuts the Bankai Fans Wanted to See Most, and It’s Perfect
content: Bleach ‘s anime is finally entering its final installment, Part 4 of the Thousand-Year Blood War arc, and as expected, it is bringing long-awaited elements of the series to a close, including finally showcasing a Bankai that remained hidden throughout the anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Bones President & Producer Explains Why MARRIAGETOXIN Was Chosen for an Anime Adaptation
content: Bones president and producer Masahiko Minami has revealed what convinced the studio to adapt MARRIAGETOXIN , saying the manga’s distinctive cast and unusual approach to action made it stand out from other series.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga Plus Adds MikotoHako Manga
content: MANGA Plus added Shintaro Tengan's MikotoHako manga in English on Monday as a simulpub title. MANGA Plus describes the story: Mikoto, a boy who lost his mother to a curse, and Hako, a girl whose face turned into a box.
author: ANN

title: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi Anime Streams Final Trailer
content: The official YouTube channels for the Star Wars franchise and Disney+ began streaming on Monday the final trailer for Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi , the limited anime series spinoff from the Star Wars: Visions project. There are versions for the English dub and the Japanese dub with English subtitles.
author: ANN

title: Yang Can't Live Alone Manga Ends Publication
content: The author is in talks with the editorial department to get Square Enix to withdraw the copyright, so they can continue the manga another way. The third compiled book volume is still scheduled to ship on August 6. However, sooncha asked people to cancel their pre-orders of the new volume if they are uncomfortable.
author: ANN

title: One Piece Day 2026 Confirms Livestream Schedule for Major Events & More
content: One Piece Day is coming back for its annual worldwide event later this month, and is gearing up for the big day with a confirmation of its livestream schedule and more tidbits about what to expect.
